mostWorthwhile.text: Following the small disk's lost material into new central stars connected the planetary system's history to the later galaxy.

leastWorthwhile.text: The central stars heating nearby gas was a fairly predictable outcome, though the resulting outflow clarified where some of the cloud went.

surprise.text: The returning tail gas continued inward toward the smaller flow around the black hole, rather than merely mixing into the extended gas.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the choices followed the locations and relationships described, although the extended-gas encounter was an inference.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow the gas moving toward the black hole and see how it connects to the earlier histories.
